name: section_subtext
label: Section Subtext
default: From schema detection to crawler control — every module targets a specific reason an AI engine might skip your page, and fixes it automatically.

default.heading: Auto-detect the right type — with a confidence score.
default.body: AEOmatic reads your post and picks from 26 schema.org types: Article, Recipe, Product, How-To, FAQ, Event and more. Every choice ships with a confidence percentage so you know when to trust it and when to override.

list_items.title: Schema types out of the box
list_items.desc: From Article to LocalBusiness to MedicalCondition — covered without configuration.

list_items.title: Confidence on every detection
list_items.desc: See exactly how sure AEOmatic is before it ships JSON-LD into your <head>.

list_items.title: One-click override
list_items.desc: Edge cases happen. Pick the right type yourself; the rest stays auto-synced.

default.heading: A clean llms.txt, generated for you.
default.body: The emerging standard — like robots.txt for answer engines — that tells LLMs which pages on your site are most worth quoting. AEOmatic writes yours automatically and updates it as you publish.

list_items.title: Auto-prioritised by content
list_items.desc: Most quotable pages bubble to the top, sorted by freshness and structure.

list_items.title: Markdown export
list_items.desc: Review offline, edit, push back. Or let AEOmatic keep it in sync.

list_items.title: Per-section opt-out
list_items.desc: Exclude private, paid, or low-quality pages with a single toggle.

default.heading: Decide which AIs can read you.
default.body: Allow the engines you want to be cited by. Block the ones you don't. AEOmatic writes the robots directives, the meta tags, and the IP-aware rules — across 18 known AI crawlers — so your policy stays consistent everywhere.

list_items.title: Named crawlers covered
list_items.desc: GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, GeminiBot, Google-Extended, Applebot, CCBot — and 11 more.

list_items.title: Per-content-type rules
list_items.desc: Block paid posts from training while letting your blog be quoted freely.

list_items.title: Audit log
list_items.desc: See what each bot last fetched — and when.

default.heading: A 0–100 AEO score, with the next thing to fix.
default.body: Every post gets a quotability score. The fixes are written as direct edits you can apply with one click — no consultant, no waiting.

list_items.title: Quotability score
list_items.desc: One number that tells you whether AI engines will pull from this page.

list_items.title: Priority-ordered fixes
list_items.desc: The biggest wins, in order, with one-click apply.

list_items.title: Trend history
list_items.desc: See how your score moves with every publish — site-wide or per-post.
